dex.text: Spins thread in an empty mill and never seems to tire. Terrible company at a dinner party, but very good at tying up loose ends.
dex.fact: Samuel Crompton invented the spinning mule near Bolton, Lancashire, in the late 1700s, which spun cotton onto many spindles at once.

dex.text: A loom spirit who goes back and forth all night. Expects you to be just as tireless, and is quietly disappointed when you are not.
dex.fact: John Kay's flying shuttle, patented in 1733, was a Lancashire invention that let weavers work much faster.
